title: 2022 HMMT February Guts Problem 6
statement: Regular polygons \(I C A O, V E N T I\), and \(A L B E D O\) lie on a plane. Given that \(I N=1\), compute the number of possible values of \(O N\).

solutions.text: First, place \(A L B E D O\). We then note that \(I C A O\) has two orientations, both of which have \(I\) on \(E O\). Next, we note that for any given orientation of \(I C A O\), the two orientations of \(V E N T I\) have \(N\) symmetric to line \(E I\). Thus, for any given orientation of \(I C A O\), we have that \(O N\) is the same in both orientations of \(V E N T I\), which gives a total of 2 possible values for \(O N\).
